page.content:
Screenwriter who first adapted Dick for the screen.

How Hampton Fancher connects

  • Work: Blade Runner (1982) — Hampton Fancher wrote key drafts of the 1982 film.
  • Work: Blade Runner 2049 — Fancher returned as a writer on 2049.

What is Hampton Fancher?

Hampton Fancher wrote the early Blade Runner screenplays and later returned as a writer on Blade Runner 2049.

Key threads lead to Blade Runner (1982) and Blade Runner 2049.
